entities.summary: The Zvezda M503 is a maritime 7 bank, 42 cylinder diesel radial engine built in the 1970s by the Soviet Union. Its primary use was in Soviet missile boats that used three of these engines and is in Russian e.g. Karakurt-class corvette.
